candidates.description: This vector activates for common Thai name suffixes and proper noun tokens, reflecting language modeling patterns for Thai morphology and named entities.
This feature vector represents common Thai syllable endings, character substrings, and subword suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant "ท" (tho thahan) and words or sub-word tokens containing it.
These tokens represent Thai script characters, tone marks, and common subword character combinations.
This vector activates on common Thai consonant clusters and syllable initial components.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to sexually explicit content, particularly terms related to pornography and adult websites.
This feature vector activates on a random mixture of multilingual text fragments, non-standard characters, and subword tokens.
This vector activates on isolated fragments of proper nouns, foreign scripts, and technical acronyms with no unifying semantic theme.
This feature vector represents subword fragments and characters from diverse multilingual and technical text.
This vector represents subword fragments and characters from Thai and English scripts, acting as a multilingual text tokenization feature.
